Q1_definition: Approximately best20percent of defined development Sharpe ranks within each basket across169 configurations; average ties retained; not a calendar quarter.
control_scope: Complete frozen Q1 validation-nonpositive census, not a matched sample; comparisons are associational, not causal.
human_authorization: Examine all69,108 as an exploratory cohort, report stricter39,332 subgroup separately, and judge screening—not crown another2026winner.
limitations: All2026dates were previously inspected elsewhere; new cohort decisions are retrospective.
Discovery universe contains historical surviving/liquid slots and conditional liquidity-tier choices.
Theoretical spot shorts, no verified historical borrow/funding/depth/impact, idealized observed-close fills and omitted drift-maintenance trades.
Common market days/shared assets/baskets/parameters are not independent trials.
A cohort median, average or profitable-case fraction is not the return of an investable portfolio.
membership_order: lexicographic experiment_id then basket_id; primary_cohort_index is the immutable row identity

resources.if_pilot_fails: Stop before bulk and disclose resource choice; do not silently sample requested survivors or shorten dates.

simulation: Unchanged inherited full warmup, basket-local signals, Monday/elapsed epoch, whole-target buffers, inactive fixed-slot budgets, lifecycle/halts and one initial entry plus terminal liquidation. No cash-reset time shards or new instrument assumptions.

statistical_design.configuration_standardization: Fixed all-Q1 mass weights among configurations having BOTH validation outcomes; exclusions/common support disclosed.
statistical_design.contrast_metric: Difference in fraction of strictly positive full-period net20bps returns
descriptive_outputs: three survivor groups across seven cost/delay scenarios
statistical_design.individual_hac: Bartlett27 daily mean t-statistic with n/(n−1) variance correction; constants undefined. Descriptive only; no individual significance tests or p-values.
statistical_design.interpretation: Positive return/median and screening lift are separate questions. Positive standardized lift with Holm4p<=0.05 is conditional exploratory evidence of association, not causal proof, independence from prior search, or deployment approval.
statistical_design.interval: 95% marginal percentile, linear quantile; conditional fixed cohort/calendar, not full-search-adjusted
statistical_design.missing_noncompoundable: Retain every status/denominator; never fill/drop daily paths. Nonfinite or noncompoundable primary daily returns block shared-calendar bootstrap and require explicit reporting.
statistical_design.multiple_testing: Holm over the four predeclared exploratory screening contrasts ONLY; not a correction over the entire research history.
statistical_design.p_value: Approximate centered two-sided paired-bootstrap +1 probability; any invalid draw yields p1 and unavailable interval.

strict_definition: Q1, evaluated and finite Sharpe both periods, strictly positive compounded net20bps lag1 return in BOTH development and validation.
